axis_aggregation_precedence.condition: any legitimately evaluable required case or comparison contains a frozen failure witness sufficient to falsify an axis obligation
axis_aggregation_precedence.note: preserve any simultaneously not-evaluable subcases, but an observed in-contract counterexample is sufficient negative evidence for the axis

axis_aggregation_precedence.condition: no legitimately evaluable required case fails, but one or more required target comparisons are outside the frozen input contract
axis_aggregation_precedence.note: do not coerce absence of admissible comparison into support or failure

axis_aggregation_precedence.condition: all required comparisons are evaluable and every frozen obligation for the axis is satisfied

G1_WORLD_NOVELTY.evaluability_condition: all 16 novel complete worlds are IN_CONTRACT_COMPLETE_SEMANTIC_COMPARISON

A1_relevant_separation.support_condition: for every held-out cube pair and every coordinate i with oracle Delta_K[i] == 1, candidate Delta_q[i] == 1
A1_relevant_separation.failure_condition: exists held-out cube pair and coordinate i with oracle Delta_K[i] == 1 and candidate Delta_q[i] == 0

A2_orthogonal_invariance.support_condition: for every held-out cube pair and every coordinate i with oracle Delta_K[i] == 0, candidate Delta_q[i] == 0
A2_orthogonal_invariance.failure_condition: exists held-out cube pair and coordinate i with oracle Delta_K[i] == 0 and candidate Delta_q[i] == 1

A3_coordinate_recoverability.support_condition: all 64 complete-world coordinate relations are EQUIVALENT
A3_coordinate_recoverability.failure_condition: any complete-world coordinate relation is NON_EQUIVALENT, UNRESOLVED_DUE_TO_COVERAGE, or UNRESOLVED_DUE_TO_CONFLICT

joint_variation.support_condition: candidate Delta_q vector exactly equals oracle Delta_K vector on all 88 multi-coordinate pairs
joint_variation.failure_reporting: retain underlying UNDER_RESOLUTION and/or COORDINATE_CONTAMINATION witnesses without inventing a composition failure type

G1_WORLD_NOVELTY.axis_support_condition: A1 supported AND A2 supported AND A3 supported AND joint_variation supported
G1_WORLD_NOVELTY.axis_negative_condition: any A1, A2, A3, or joint_variation failure witness exists

G2_OBSERVATION_CHANNEL_NOVELTY.axis_support_condition: every required G2 target-role case is evaluable under the frozen binding and all corresponding semantic/separability obligations are satisfied
G2_OBSERVATION_CHANNEL_NOVELTY.axis_not_supported_condition: at least one required target-role case is legitimately evaluable and contains a frozen semantic/separability counterexample
G2_OBSERVATION_CHANNEL_NOVELTY.axis_not_evaluable_condition: no legitimately evaluable required target-role case fails, and at least one required target-role semantic carrier remains outside the frozen input contract

G3_COVERAGE_DEGRADATION.per_control_support_condition: candidate_set relation == EQUAL AND candidate unresolved-identity coordinates exactly equal the oracle-supported incomplete-coordinate set
G3_COVERAGE_DEGRADATION.axis_support_condition: all four controls satisfy the per-control support condition
G3_COVERAGE_DEGRADATION.axis_negative_condition: any one of the four controls violates the per-control support condition

required_evidence: mixed L-change plus V-conflict descriptive record
G4_FAILURE_STRUCTURE_NOVELTY.novel_cube_component: reuse G1 A1/A2/A3 and joint-variation rules on the held-out semantic realizations
G4_FAILURE_STRUCTURE_NOVELTY.mixed_component_support_condition: for g5_law_validity_competing_pressure, definite-change set relation == EQUAL with {L} and conflict-set relation == EQUAL with {V}; the candidate must preserve definite L change while preserving unresolved V conflict
G4_FAILURE_STRUCTURE_NOVELTY.mixed_component_negative_condition: definite-change set relation != EQUAL OR conflict-set relation != EQUAL OR the candidate coerces the V conflict into a unique resolved validity identity
G4_FAILURE_STRUCTURE_NOVELTY.axis_negative_condition: novel_cube_component has any frozen failure witness OR mixed_component_negative_condition holds

G5_COORDINATE_CONTRADICTION_OR_CONFLICTI.per_control_support_condition: definite-change set relation == EQUAL AND conflict-set relation == EQUAL, with no conflicted coordinate coerced into a unique resolved semantic identity
G5_COORDINATE_CONTRADICTION_OR_CONFLICTI.per_control_negative_condition: definite-change set relation != EQUAL OR conflict-set relation != EQUAL OR a conflicted coordinate is coerced into a unique resolved semantic identity
G5_COORDINATE_CONTRADICTION_OR_CONFLICTI.axis_support_condition: all three conflict controls satisfy the per-control support condition
G5_COORDINATE_CONTRADICTION_OR_CONFLICTI.axis_negative_condition: any conflict control satisfies the per-control negative condition
G5_COORDINATE_CONTRADICTION_OR_CONFLICTI.negative_reporting_rule: preserve the exact definite-change and conflict set relations; do not invent a truth-adjudication or causal failure class
